prompt: From a sleeping bag in the doorway at the foot of a glass office tower at night, looking straight up its side: every floor above lit cold white, rows of empty desks and glowing screens and server racks, nobody anywhere inside, the tower climbing into low cloud. A pair of worn trainers in the bottom of the frame. Winter night in a near-future Britain, the streetlights dead, lit only by braziers, camping lanterns and the glow of the city's towers; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
